replies.text: “For context, most customers want a rough sense of what data‑plane usage typically looks like in production. While actual costs vary, we can share directional estimates based on what we see across similar deployments. For a medium‑sized financial institution—roughly 25 active projects and about 200,000 prompts per day—data‑plane usage generally lands around $1,200 per month. It’s important to note that only part of the cost scales linearly with prompt volume. Roughly half of the spend is tied to fixed or semi‑fixed components (such as infrastructure). Because of this, an organization sending 20,000 prompts per day won’t see a simple 10× reduction. Instead, their monthly cost is typically closer to $700, not $120. At the higher end, a large enterprise processing around 2 million prompts per day usually sees data‑plane costs in the range of $8,000 per month. --- ### ⚠️ Important Disclaimers These figures are directional estimates, not quotes. Actual costs depend on several factors, including: - Prompt size and complexity (larger prompts require more processing) - Guardrail configuration (number and type of policies applied per request). Configure the job: | Field | Value | |---|---| | **URL Endpoint** | `<your Atlas tenant API URL>/v1/ai-usage/log-push/format/datadog` | | **Datadog API Key** | *(Paste the Datadog Listener API Key from Step 1)* | | **ddsource** | `cloudflare` | | Other fields | Optional — leave blank | 6. root.text: Some additional instructions for adding the Claude Compliance API integration. These came from Support. Enable the Compliance API for the parent organization (one-time). The primary owner enables it in claude.ai. If compliance scopes are not selectable when creating a key, it has not been enabled yet. Go to claude.ai → Organization settings → API (https://claude.ai/admin-settings/api-access ) → Keys section. Click Create key, name it, and select the scopes read:compliance_org_data and read:compliance_user_data (these cover the org metadata, users, chats, and messages Atlas reads). Click Create. Copy the secret — it begins with sk-ant-api01- (a Compliance Access Key). It is shown only once. Do not use an Admin API key (sk-ant-admin01-..., Activity-Feed only) or a standard Claude API key (sk-ant-api03-..., model calls only) — neither can read chats/org data and both will 403.
